cards.stem: Which item is listed among the factors that influence lift
cards.quote: The amount of lift generated by an object depends on a number of factors, including properties of the air, the velocity between the object and the air
cards.hint: Check the opening list of influences on lift

cards.stem: According to early findings, how does lift change with speed and area
cards.quote: it had been determined that lift depends on the square of the velocity and varies linearly with the surface area of the object
cards.hint: Recall how lift was said to scale with speed

cards.stem: In the early lift relation, what does the symbol k denote
cards.quote: where L is the lift, k is the Smeaton coefficient, V is the velocity, A is the wing area, and cl is the lift coefficient.
cards.hint: Look at the definition of each term in the equation
